title: garden bed manifest
description: What a bed of the plotplot garden declares about itself, so the umbrella can verify the fit contract without reading the bed's source. [flagged] proposal: the manifest schema belongs to the contracts repository, which does not exist yet. Until it does, this file is vendored here and the shape may still move.

$schema.description: The schema this manifest was written against.

name.description: The bed's name, lowercase, as the binary and the brand layer spell it.

summary.description: One sentence saying what the bed is.

kind.description: What the bed is to the garden. A gate judges and may block; a hook answers a harness or git; a skill is read by an agent; an mcp face is spoken to over stdio; a library is depended on by other beds.

version.description: The released version, equal to the one the bed's own package manifest carries.

install.description: How the bed arrives, per platform. At least one route, and the binary route names every target triple a release publishes.

npm.description: The command that installs the npm wrapper.

cargo.description: The command that installs from crates.io.

binary.description: The release archives, by target triple.

url.description: Where an archive is fetched from. {version} is the manifest's version and {asset} is the archive named under targets.

targets.description: Target triple to the archive the release publishes for it.

faces.description: The commands the bed offers, named as a caller types them.

skill.description: Where the bed's SKILL.md lives, so the stem can install it into a harness's discovery directory.

check.description: The command whose findings the umbrella reads, and the standard it emits them in.

format.description: The standard and its version, as <standard>-<version>.

metric.description: The one number the bed is measured by, the command that produces it, and where its latest result is committed.

latest.description: The committed summary of the metric's latest result — its value, its interval, its date, and the version measured.

context_cost.description: Tokens the bed adds to an agent's session before it is called. A binary a caller runs costs nothing until it is run.

flagged.description: Claims in this repository the owner has not confirmed. Each names what is provisional and what would settle it.
